hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/package.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; (cd "$d" && pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f") >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; }
if jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi && (pnpm run typecheck 1>&2 || exit 2) && (pnpm run lint 1>&2 || exit 2)
